prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「燃烧」？
我到达之前，火车已经离开了。哪一句正确？

choices.text: The train has left when I arrived.
The train had left when I arrive.
The train had left when I arrived.
The train left when I had arrived as the earlier event.

explanation: 先离开用 had left，后到达用 arrived。
verify: "The train had left when I arrived."

prompt: 到我起床时，哥哥已经走了。哪一句正确？

choices.text: By the time I got up, my brother has left.
By the time I got up, my brother had leave.
By the time I get up, my brother had left.
By the time I got up, my brother had left.

explanation: had left 发生在 got up 之前。
verify: "By the time I got up, my brother had left."

prompt: 过去完成时的结构是哪一个？
她发现背包烧了，那是在她回来之前发生的。哪一句正确？

choices.text: She found that her backpack has burned.
She found that her backpack had burned.
She found that her backpack had burn.
She had found that her backpack burned first after she found it.

explanation: burned 发生在 found 之前，用 had burned。
verify: "She found that her backpack had burned."

prompt: 想说你迟到是因为闹钟没响，哪一句合适？

I was late because my alarm had not gone off.

explanation: had not gone off 在迟到之前。

prompt: 背包忘在家里了，哪一句合适？
